description: Published in a game's own repository to revoke compromised, exploited, or mistakenly signed achievement unlocks or leaderboard scores.

main.description: Revokes inline cryptographic attestations previously signed by this game publisher. Must be published in the same repository (DID) that owns the referenced `subject` definition. For `scope: "attestation"`, set `rkey` to the `attestationCid` so lightweight clients can check revocation in O(1) via `com.atproto.repo.getRecord` and cheaters cannot evade revocation by copying a signed record to a new `rkey`. Deleting this record reinstates the revoked attestation(s).

scope.description: `attestation` revokes a single signed payload identified by `attestationCid`; `achievement`, `leaderboard`, or `game` revokes all signed records for `player` matching `subject` (optionally bounded by `before`).

attestationCid.description: Deterministic DAG-CBOR CIDv1 (`bafy...`) of the signed payload being revoked. Required when `scope` is `attestation`. Binding revocation to `attestationCid` rather than only `recordUri` prevents a player from re-uploading the same signed record under a different `rkey`.

player.description: DID of the player whose signed record(s) are revoked.

subject.description: AT-URI of the `achievement.definition`, `leaderboard.definition`, or `games.atmosphere.define` record in this publisher's repository to which the revocation applies.

recordUri.description: Optional AT-URI of the offending `achievement.unlock` or `leaderboard.score` record observed in the player's repository, preserved for auditability.

before.description: Optional cutoff timestamp for `achievement`, `leaderboard`, or `game` scopes. When set, only records with `unlockedAt` / `recordedAt` at or before `before` are revoked (e.g. invalidating pre-patch exploit runs while allowing fair post-patch play).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code for the revocation.

note.description: Optional human-readable explanation written by the game publisher.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when this revocation was published.
